name: Setira of the Coven
bio: Setira and her coven are devoted to making the fastest broom ever. But when flying at blistering speeds, how do you ensure rapid reflexes? Enter their clowder of magical cats, each one a highly trained co-pilot. Setira's cat, Senna, is especially gifted, being able to cast spells mid-flight to increase Setira's reactions. What a good kitty.

effects.label: Harden
effects.description: Decreases the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Immunity
effects.description: Blocks Debuffs from being applied to the recipient.Immunity Buffs will not block Control Debuffs, and each Immunity buff will only negate a single Debuff before expiring. This buff can be stacked.

effects.label: Combo SPD Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Combo Speed stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Skill SPD Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Skill Speed stat by the indicated percentage.
